official_measurement_examples: water-discharge permit need depends on the activity and applicable exemption/general-binding-rule context
surface-water discharge and groundwater activity are distinct permit categories
standard-rules and bespoke permits are distinct routes
environmental permit is separate from planning permission
permit conditions remain binding after grant
the 20 April 2026 guidance update states 20 working days for specified SR2025 standard-rules permits but this is not a universal permit timetable
variation transfer and surrender are separate permit lifecycle actions
permit status does not establish land ownership drainage feasibility or final development yield
core_rules: environmental permit is not planning permission
planning permission is not environmental permit
surface-water and groundwater activities remain distinct
bespoke and standard permits remain distinct
permit grant is not evidence conditions are complied with
general binding rules are not bespoke permits
small sewage rules are not all water-discharge activities
variation is not new planning permission
transfer is not ownership of land
surrender is not proof of no residual risk
permit does not calculate development yield
no parcel water-discharge clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
